lines: I bounced, I bounced, I bounced like a grade-schooler
Bounced in the night after the rain, like a skipping stone
Passing straight through tomorrow
Passing straight through morning
You bounced too, you bounced, like a schoolgirl
Bounced on top of a puddle, like a water strider
Which is to say
Where should we go, where should we go — are we trying to stay right here?
I'll run away, I'll run away, just a little longer
You vanished, you vanished, like a mirage
The sound of the sudden shower vanished too, as if saying goodbye
Just as you said
Where should we go, where should we go — are we trying to stay right here?
Even running, even running, there's no sound anymore
I'll become the rain and catch up a few minutes later
Crying now, I'll go on a few minutes later
Myself, a few minutes after crying now
Crying now, I'll go on a few minutes later
Crying now, I'll say it a few minutes later
Myself, years after crying now
I can go, I can go — I'm trying to go far away
Picture it, picture it — toward wherever I want
I'll become the rain and catch up a few minutes later
Crying now, I'll go on a few minutes later
Myself, a few minutes after crying now
Crying now, I'll say it a few minutes later
Myself, years after crying now
You'd want to be laughing, wouldn't you
